description: Brute-force virtual hosts by fuzzing the Host header. Returns baseline_length, results (vhost/status/length/length_delta), unique_vhosts, and tested count. Read-only, sends one request per wordlist entry.

base_domain.description: Base domain for vhost names, e.g. hackycorp.com

target.description: Target IP or domain to send requests to

wordlist.description: Path to wordlist file. Uses built-in common subdomains if not provided.

name: recon_vhost
